purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official ILRMS portal identifies BhuNaksha as cadastral-mapping software. The public map interface shows location selectors and dag/map detail controls, and the Land Records Directorate lists the Silchar Revenue Circle in Cachar. The map page did not expose an exact selectable revenue village or safe anonymous geometry endpoint from the available interface; Dag detail fields include owner and deed information, which were not queried or retained.
registryAssessment: Assam’s cadastral map system and the Silchar Revenue Circle are first-party sources. The exact WUP point’s revenue village and whether it has public cadastral geometry remain unverified.
